subject: Request: Onboarding allowance carveout — approval playbook & ops checklist
messages:
From: Kate Johnson <kate@skylinelabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skylinelabs.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — onboarding allowance carveout for Skyline Accelerator portfolio

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our accelerator team is putting together a sponsorship package for the next cohort and we want Redwood to be a preferred infrastructure partner. Two asks from our side:

1) A one-time onboarding allowance applied to new startups accepted into the cohort (we call it the "onboarding allowance").
2) A short-term promotional uplift (30 days) that gives teams access to higher throughput for initial demos without immediate billing.

We understand Redwood has standard promotional rules but this is a partner-sponsored program and the startups will sign up under Skyline accounts for the first 90 days. Our procurement team needs a written approval playbook outlining approvals, billing carveouts, and guardrails (usage caps, conversion triggers). Can you share a checklist we can present to finance?

Attaching a one-page overview of the accelerator sponsorship. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Kate Johnson
Head of Partnerships — Skyline Labs
Attachments: skyline-accelerator-sponsorship-onepager.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Kate Johnson <kate@skylinelabs.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — onboarding allowance carveout for Skyline Accelerator portfolio

Ben / Laura — FYI, Skyline is asking for a partner-sponsored onboarding allowance + 30-day demo uplift for cohort startups. They want an "approval playbook" for their procurement team. High level asks:

- One-time onboarding allowance applied at account creation (not stackable with other promos).
- Short-term throughput uplift (time-limited SKU override) that reverts after 30 days or on conversion.
- Clear conversion trigger: opt-in to paid account within 90 days or usage-based billing kicks in.

Initial thoughts: suggest we treat this as a promotional carveout with guardrails: cap allowance per startup, require sponsorship agreement, and sign-off from RevOps for ledger entry. Ben — what discretionary authority do you have here for onboarding allowances? Laura — what ops steps do we need (promo codes, PO, HubSpot tagging)?

I started a draft playbook (attached) with recommended thresholds. Please review and advise limits we can sign off on without escalating.

— Mina
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachments: onboarding-allowance-playbook-draft.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — onboarding allowance carveout for Skyline Accelerator portfolio

Quick internal reply before we send a formal to Kate:

Proposed commercial guardrails (recommendation):
- Standard onboarding allowance baseline: $1,500 per startup (covers first 30 days).
- Partner-sponsored uplift (this ask): allow up to $5,000 per startup for strategic partners, but requires Ops & finance sign-off if aggregate > $50k per cohort.
- Uplift must be timeboxed to 30 days and have a monthly max per account to prevent runaway usage.
- Conversion trigger: a paid billing agreement or commit to Dedicated within 90 days; otherwise auto-disable uplift.

Approval matrix I can sign off on: up to $15k total outbound allowance per partner per quarter. Anything > $15k and < $50k needs Mina's approval. > $50k requires VP or CRO approval (we should route via sales leadership).

Operational notes for Laura:
- Create a partner promo SKU (PD-ONB-PARTNER) with per-account cap and cohort tag.
- Ops to generate a one-off invoice flow and flag HubSpot company "Skyline Labs" with the promo link.
- Require purchase order or sponsor declaration to enable allowance.

If this looks reasonable I can draft a short approval email for procurement and include the approval matrix.

Ben
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kate Johnson <kate@skylinelabs.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — onboarding allowance carveout for Skyline Accelerator portfolio

Hi Kate, Mina, Ben — thanks for the details. Operational checklist and next steps below (I'll owner-operate this with Revenue Ops):

Ops checklist (high-level):
- Legal: add short billing addendum to standard T&C explicitly allowing partner-sponsored onboarding allowances; include reversion and data export clauses. Owner: Legal (need lead).
- Accounting: map allowance to contra-revenue line and create revenue recognition rule for sponsored credits. Owner: Accounting.
- RevOps: create promo SKU PD-ONB-PARTNER with per-account cap fields, cohort tag, and auto-expiry 30 days from enablement. Owner: RevOps (me).
- Billing: require sponsor PO or DocuSign approval to enable promo at account creation. Owner: Billing team.
- CRM: Tag company + child accounts in HubSpot and link to deal id; add usage guardrail notes. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890. Owner: Sales Ops.
- Reporting: include a weekly promo-usage report during the cohort window; escalate if >80% of allowance used in first 10 days. Owner: Analytics.

Suggested values (to align with Ben):
- Per-startup cap: $5,000 (partner-sponsored option)
- Preferred baseline: $1,500 (standard non-sponsor onboarding)
- Partner quarterly outbound cap without exec sign-off: $15,000

DocuSign & HubSpot steps: we will provision a DocuSign envelope with the billing addendum and the sponsor declaration. Please confirm procurement contact (procurement@skylinelabs.com) — we'll send the envelope and the promo activation link. DocuSign draft (pending legal): https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABCDEF123456

Deliverables I'll send by EOD tomorrow: 1) Ops checklist workbook (ops-checklist.xlsx), 2) DocuSign envelope draft, 3) HubSpot tagging playbook.

Laura Bennett
RevOps Program Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: ops-checklist.xlsx
